T: Eat the chocolate. You'll feel better.
D: An escaped prisoner is said to be after Harry, and the guards sent to protect the school are worse.
P: Serve the chocolate when Professor Lupin hands Harry a piece after the Dementors.
S: the chocolate Lupin gives Harry after the Dementors
Good dark and milk chocolate broken into rough pieces, with a slab of homemade honeycomb (sugar, golden syrup and bicarb) dipped half in chocolate.
the sweet shop in the wizarding village
Sugared jellies, peppermint humbugs, fudge squares and coconut ice piled into glass jars, a scoop for each guest.
the divination class reading tea leaves
Earl Grey shortbread: tea leaves ground into butter, sugar and flour, rolled into a log, chilled, sliced, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
M: the old pub in London where Harry stays
Beef chuck browned in batches, dark ale, onion, carrot and thyme, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Crusty bread and butter.
the purple triple-decker bus at night
Toasted cheese and ham sandwiches made in a hot pan, with a cup of tomato soup for dunking.
W: Creamy vanilla fudge cut into thick squares, wrapped in paper like the shop sells it.
K: Pumpkin, apple juice and a little honey blended smooth with cinnamon and ginger, strained and served cold.

s.note: the chocolate Lupin gives Harry after the Dementors
s.how: Boil 150g sugar and 4 tbsp golden syrup to amber, whisk in 2 tsp bicarb and pour into a lined tin to set. Break into slabs and dip half in 100g melted dark chocolate. Serve with 100g milk chocolate broken into rough pieces.

s.note: the divination class reading tea leaves
s.how: Grind 2 tsp Earl Grey tea leaves and beat into 200g butter with 80g icing sugar and lemon zest. Mix in 280g flour, roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Read the crumbs.

m.note: the old pub in London where Harry stays
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots with thyme. Add 375ml ale and 400ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with crusty bread and butter.

w.how: Melt 395g condensed milk, 150ml milk, 450g brown sugar and 115g butter, then boil to 115C, stirring all the time. Take off the heat, beat 5 minutes until thick, pour into a lined 20cm tin and cool before cutting.

d.how: Roast 400g butternut pumpkin at 200C for 30 minutes until soft and cool. Blend with 750ml apple juice, 1 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and 1/4 tsp ginger until smooth, strain and chill. Serve in 4 glasses over ice.
